claim_boundary: The interval EFT/RG packet of the validation lane: one pure Standard Model interval with census-derived one-loop gauge beta coefficients, frozen schemes, imported finite maps recorded as imports, a symbolic interval Jacobian, a declared truncation remainder, and one canonical typed output vector. No numeric coupling value exists anywhere in this packet, and nothing promotes.

gauge_betas.convention: d g_i / d ln Q = b_i g_i^3 / (16 pi^2), SM hypercharge normalization for b1

derivation.formula: b = -(11/3) C2(adjoint) + (2/3) sum_Weyl T(R) + (1/3) sum_complex_scalar T(R)

gut_normalized_b1.reason: the lane freezes the SM hypercharge normalization; the GUT value is recorded for refusal only

decoupling_maps.reason: no threshold crosses a pure Standard Model interval; the empty list is a recorded statement, not an omission

intervals.operator_basis: the retained renormalizable basis of the action bundle

jacobian.definition: the one-loop linearization d g_i(Q2) / d g_j(Q1) of the interval flow
jacobian.form: diagonal at one loop in the gauge sector: delta_ij (1 + 3 b_i g_i^2 t / (16 pi^2)) with t = ln(Q2/Q1), symbolic

output_vector.name: SM_MSbar_FJ(Q)
output_vector.note: one canonical typed vector; every component is a symbol and the chart vev keeps its type from the action bundle

remainder.definition: the two-loop truncation term of the interval flow
remainder.status: declared deterministic remainder symbol; it is carried, never estimated without inputs

drbar_to_msbar_finite_maps.gauge_shift: g_DRbar^2 = g_MSbar^2 (1 + C2(adjoint) g^2/(24 pi^2) x epsilon-scheme term), recorded as imported structure with symbolic coupling
drbar_to_msbar_finite_maps.reason: the finite scheme shifts are standard imported structure; no numeric value is fabricated

scheme_freeze.output_coordinate: the frozen FJ coordinate of the downstream strict pole-map contract

census_group_factors.yukawa_trace_multiplicity: Tr over the full three-by-three sector matrices of the action bundle

imported_kernel_shapes: one-loop Yukawa beta: (Nc + 3/2) y^3 - like terms minus gauge Casimir subtractions
one-loop quartic beta: quartic, Yukawa-trace, and gauge-quartic terms
